kaikki_vikisozluk.e: بَنْغَازِيّ or بِنْغَازِي • (banḡāziyy or binḡāzī) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Apparently from earlier مرسى بني غازي (“port of ibn Ghazi”) first attested on a 1579 map by Ali al-Sharfi. Possibly a reference to a Muslim holy man Sidi ibn Ghazi. "Ibn Ghazi" itself can literally be translated as "son of the ghazi (warrior)".
g: Benghazi (a port city in eastern Libya).
